summary: Gap-filling pass over the Europe, Turkey, Egypt/Jordan, Asia, Hong Kong, Oceania, Africa and historical items in GAPS.md. The biggest gains are official: Montenegro's own programme reports (2021 and 2026), Hong Kong ImmD year-end CIES totals 2009-2023 with the final HK$316.9 billion, Hungary's ÁKK settlement-bond stocks for the missing years, Portugal's SEF monthly maps for Jan-Aug 2023, UK settlement grants to investors 2008-2018, Greece's December 2021 golden-visa stock, and the gazette text of Egypt's 2019 decree. Several other gaps remain blocked (Malta, Cyprus, Mauritius, France), and the Wayback Machine went offline mid-pass.

sources.title: Законопроект за изменение на Закона за българското гражданство, № 47-202-01-2, с мотиви и Решение № 12 на Министерския съвет от 14 януари 2022 г. (Government bill to amend the Bulgarian Citizenship Act, with explanatory memorandum)
sources.publisher: Народно събрание на Република България / Министерски съвет (National Assembly / Council of Ministers)
sources.covers: Government bill repealing arts. 12a and 14a (citizenship for investors), the Council of Ministers decision approving it, and the reasons: investments found to have been sold before naturalisation, minimal residence, Commission letter of June 2021.
sources.notes: Word file from the parliament's bills archive. The cover letter is dated '18.01.2021 г.', an evident typo for 2022 (the Council of Ministers decision is of 14 Jan 2022 and the file was created 18 Jan 2022). The memorandum gives no counts of investor naturalisations. Its transitional § 5 would have let pending applications be decided under the old rules; the law finally adopted terminated them instead.
